verdict.rationale: ClickHouse itself is a SQL-driven database, but it ships an official MCP server (mcp-clickhouse) and 'agent skills' that let AI assistants translate natural-language requests into ClickHouse operations, and a runtime probe confirms the MCP server completes a real keyless JSON-RPC handshake exposing tools for AI clients. This is not native NL parsing inside ClickHouse itself—it depends on an external AI assistant/agent framework to interpret language, so the story is only partially satisfied. missing for 10: built-in NL interface without external MCP client, independent hands-on evidence of a full NL-to-query session, documentation of NL command coverage/limits.
